metadata.remarks: Cross-Cloud Governance defines the trust properties required to ensure that security policy intent, enforcement expectations, and assurance remain consistent across multiple cloud providers. This pattern recognizes that multi-cloud risk most often arises from governance gaps, semantic differences, and uneven assurance rather than from individual cloud platform failures.

components.title: Policy Intent Normalization
components.description: Expression of security policy intent in a provider-agnostic form to avoid semantic drift.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Consistent security architecture principles applied across providers.

props.name: defense-technique
